intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Olorin.ai LLC ("we," "our," or "the Company") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how our mobile application, Bayit+ (the "App"), collects, uses, and safeguards your information.
intro.commitment: We built Bayit+ with a "Privacy-First" architecture. We do not record your living room. Our technology uses your device's sensors solely to synchronize our audio service with your television.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect & How We Use It

camera.title: A. Camera & Visual Synchronization Data
camera.intro: To provide our core service—synchronizing translated audio with your TV—Bayit+ requires access to your device's Camera.
camera.data: Data Collected: When you activate "Sync Mode," the App captures a short sequence of video frames (approximately 3 seconds) from your TV screen.
camera.purpose: Purpose: These frames are transmitted to our secure cloud server solely to identify the public TV channel you are watching and calculate the broadcast latency (time delay).
camera.retention: Retention: This data is ephemeral. The frames are processed instantly in memory and are permanently deleted immediately after the synchronization is established. We do not view, store, or archive images of your home or family.

audio.title: B. Audio Data (If Applicable)
audio.intro: If you utilize features requiring audio synchronization, the App may request Microphone access.
audio.data: Data Collected: Brief audio samples of the TV broadcast.
audio.purpose: Purpose: To match the audio fingerprint of the public broadcast for synchronization purposes.
audio.retention: Retention: Like visual data, audio samples are processed in real-time and immediately deleted. We do not listen to or record user conversations.

usage.title: C. Usage & Technical Data
usage.content: We may collect non-identifiable technical data to improve App stability, including:
usage.device: Device type and operating system version.
usage.aggregate: Aggregate data on which channels are being watched (e.g., "50% of users are watching Channel 12").

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing and Third Parties
sharing.noSale: Olorin.ai LLC does not sell your personal data. We partner with trusted third-party service providers to deliver our infrastructure. These providers are authorized to use your data only as necessary to provide these services to us:
sharing.cloud: Cloud Infrastructure: Hosting services (e.g., AWS) to process synchronization requests.
sharing.ai: AI Processing: Services used to generate real-time text and audio translations from public broadcast feeds.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention
retention.sync: Sync Data (Images/Audio): 0 days. Deleted immediately after processing.
retention.account: Account Data: Retained only as long as your account is active to manage your subscription and preferences.

children.title: 5. Children's Privacy
children.content: While our content is suitable for all ages, Olorin.ai LLC does not knowingly collect personal identifiable information from children under the age of 13. If you are a parent and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: Depending on your location, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. You may delete your Bayit+ account at any time within the App settings.

pause_ask.name: Pause & Ask
pause_ask.tagline: Pause any movie and chat with the characters
pause_ask.description: Pause a movie and have a real conversation with any character. They respond in their own voice and personality, answering questions about the plot, their motivations, or anything else you want to know.

interactive_subtitles.name: Interactive Subtitles
interactive_subtitles.tagline: Tap any subtitle word to learn its meaning
interactive_subtitles.description: Turn subtitles into a learning tool. Tap any word to see its definition, hear pronunciation, and save it to your vocabulary list. Works with Hebrew, English, and bilingual subtitle tracks.

vocabulary.name: Vocabulary Builder
vocabulary.tagline: Build your personal word bank from movies
vocabulary.description: Collect words from interactive subtitles into a personal vocabulary list. Review flashcards, track your progress, and see words in context from the movies where you learned them.

vod_moments.name: Interactive Moments
vod_moments.tagline: React to key scenes with AI-powered interactions
vod_moments.description: At key moments in a movie, interactive prompts appear letting you engage with the story. Ask questions, get cultural context, or dive deeper into pivotal scenes.

cultural_context.name: Cultural Context
cultural_context.tagline: Understand the cultural meaning behind every scene
cultural_context.description: Get AI-generated cultural explanations for scenes, dialogue, and references that might be unfamiliar. Understand Israeli humor, religious customs, historical references, and more.

bilingual_bridge.name: Bilingual Bridge
bilingual_bridge.tagline: Learn Hebrew naturally through movie dialogue
bilingual_bridge.description: See both Hebrew and English subtitles side by side. The AI highlights key phrases and helps you understand Hebrew dialogue in the natural context of a movie conversation.

ai_companion.name: AI Companion
ai_companion.description: An AI assistant that watches along with you. Ask about the plot, characters, or production details at any time. It understands the context of what you are watching and gives relevant answers.

live_dubbing.name: Live Dubbing
live_dubbing.tagline: Watch any channel dubbed in your language
live_dubbing.description: Real-time AI dubbing of live Israeli TV channels into English, Spanish, French, and more. Hear the content in your preferred language while watching live broadcasts.

live_subtitles.name: Live Subtitles
live_subtitles.description: AI-generated subtitles appear in real time as you watch live TV. Choose your preferred language and follow along with any Hebrew broadcast.

live_trivia.name: Live Trivia
live_trivia.tagline: Play trivia games about what you are watching
live_trivia.description: AI detects the topic of the live broadcast and generates trivia questions in real time. Compete with other viewers and test your knowledge of Israeli culture, news, and entertainment.

catch_up.name: Catch Up Summary
catch_up.tagline: Get an AI summary of what you missed
catch_up.description: Joined a live broadcast late? The AI generates a quick summary of everything that happened before you tuned in, so you can jump right in without missing context.

scene_search.name: Scene Search
scene_search.tagline: Find any moment in a recorded broadcast
scene_search.description: Search through recorded live TV content by describing what you are looking for. The AI finds the exact moment and takes you right to it.

phonetic_mirror.name: Phonetic Mirror
phonetic_mirror.tagline: Practice Hebrew pronunciation with AI feedback
phonetic_mirror.description: Read a Hebrew phrase and speak it aloud. The AI analyzes your pronunciation, shows you where to improve, and demonstrates the correct sounds using your avatar as a visual guide.

talk_back.name: Talk Back
talk_back.tagline: Practice Hebrew conversation with your avatar
talk_back.description: Have a Hebrew conversation with your AI avatar. It speaks to you in Hebrew, you respond, and it gives feedback on your pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary usage.

interactive_mission.name: Interactive Mission
interactive_mission.tagline: Complete Hebrew learning missions with AI guidance
interactive_mission.description: Embark on guided Hebrew learning missions. Your avatar leads you through interactive exercises combining speaking, listening, and reading practice in fun, gamified scenarios.

glossary.name: Hebrew Glossary
glossary.tagline: Browse and search the Hebrew vocabulary database
glossary.description: Access a comprehensive Hebrew-English glossary. Search for words, hear pronunciations, see usage examples from Bayit+ content, and save words to your personal vocabulary list.

llm_search.name: AI Search
llm_search.description: Describe what you want to watch in your own words. The AI understands your intent and finds matching movies, shows, and channels from the entire Bayit+ catalog.

proactive_voice.name: Voice Suggestions
proactive_voice.tagline: Get personalized content suggestions by voice
proactive_voice.description: Activate voice mode and tell Bayit+ what you are in the mood for. The AI considers your watch history, preferences, and current time to suggest the perfect content.

chatbot.name: AI Assistant
chatbot.tagline: Ask anything about Bayit+ and Israeli content
chatbot.description: Chat with the Bayit+ AI assistant about anything. Get help navigating the app, learn about Israeli culture, find content recommendations, or ask questions about your account and features.
